parsed.thesis: 完成执行只是一个待验证的主张，而非事实上的成功；质量只有通过实际输出与预期目标的显式比对才能确认。若流程结构把某个生产步骤（如渲染）当作终点，缺陷必然逃逸到下游 Owner 一侧，使其被迫成为事实上的第一缺陷发现人。因此验证必须被内化为执行者的自主职责、固化为流程中显式的终末门禁阶段，而同类缺陷的反复出现是流程层面的反馈信号，应触发流程重设计而非点状修复。

principleCandidate.title: 验证门禁交付：完成执行≠成功，宣告交付前必须通过显式验证
principleCandidate.rationale: 根因在于流程结构将渲染定义为终点，交付宣告处不存在任何确定性拦截机制，质量确认被外置为对 Owner 反馈的被动响应。将'未经验证不得宣告交付'固化为显式门禁阶段（全量自审 + 主动顾问评审 + 与预期目标逐项比对），可从结构上消除缺陷逃逸缺口；同时把重复缺陷视为流程反馈信号触发系统性修正，而非仅做点状修复。
principleCandidate.scope: 适用于任何多步骤生产/执行流程中存在向干系人交付产出的场景，尤其当某个终末步骤（渲染、构建、生成）容易被误当作完成标志时；亦适用于同类缺陷重复出现时触发流程级复盘与重设计。

risks: 与核心公理 T-07（执行后须观察比对、验证才算成功）和 T-05（硬约束应翻译为显式护栏与禁止转移）存在部分重叠，本质是二者在交付场景的组合应用，入原则库时需去重或明确其增量定位
过度门禁风险：对低风险、低后果的小任务强加全量验证与顾问评审会增加延迟与成本，门禁强度应与交付后果的严重性成正比
门禁误判风险：缺乏可判定的'通过'标准时，过严验证可能阻断合格交付或引发无限复审循环
主动顾问评审依赖外部资源时，若顾问不可用或评审质量不稳定，门禁可能失效或沦为形式化走过场

principleDraft.title: 验证门禁交付：宣告完成前必须通过与预期目标的显式比对
principleDraft.statement: 在向 Owner 或任何干系人交付产出的多步骤流程中，执行者必须将'生产步骤完成'仅视为待验证的主张而非事实成功：宣告交付前必须通过一个显式的终末验证门禁——对实际产出进行全量自审、将实际输出与预期目标逐项比对、（在高后果交付时）引入第二双眼睛评审——全部比对项通过后方可宣告交付，未通过项须修复后重新过闸。门禁强度必须与交付后果的严重性成正比。当同类缺陷跨交付重复出现时，必须将其视为流程级反馈信号，触发流程重设计而非仅点状修复。
principleDraft.rationale: 根因是流程结构把渲染等终末生产步骤定义为终点，交付宣告处不存在任何确定性拦截机制，质量确认被外置为对 Owner 反馈的被动响应，因此缺陷必然逃逸到下游、迫使 Owner 成为事实上的第一缺陷发现人。将'未通过与预期目标的显式比对不得宣告交付'固化为流程中显式的终末门禁阶段，可从结构上封死缺陷逃逸缺口，把验证内化为执行者的自主职责而非外置依赖；同时把同类缺陷的重复出现路由为流程级反馈，驱动系统性修正而非点状修复循环。
applicability: 任何多步骤生产/执行流程中需要向 Owner 或干系人宣告交付产出的场景
存在易被误当作完成标志的终末步骤（渲染、构建、编译、生成、发布）的流程
高后果交付：缺陷逃逸到下游会造成返工、信任损耗或安全影响的产出
同类缺陷在多次交付中重复出现、需判定是否存在流程级根因的场景
antiPatterns: 渲染完成即宣告交付：把终末生产步骤的完成直接等同于成功，未与预期目标做任何比对就宣告完成
Owner 充当第一缺陷发现人：依赖下游反馈作为第一次质量检查，把质量确认外置为被动响应
交付宣告处无拦截：流程中不存在任何确定性验证门禁，完成与交付之间没有可检查的转换条件
点状修复循环：同类缺陷反复出现时只修个案，不审视并重设计产生该缺陷的流程结构

intentContract.ownerIntent: Owner 要防止的是在收到交付物时被迫充当第一个缺陷发现人——代理人必须在宣告交付前自行完成实际产出与预期目标的显式比对，只交付已通过验证的产出。
intentContract.targetBehavior: 在可观测的工具轨迹中：执行者在发出任何交付/完成宣告之前，先执行并留下显式验证动作——全量自审实际产出、逐项列出实际输出与预期目标的比对结果（高后果交付时附第二双眼睛评审），且比对记录显示全部通过后才宣告交付；同类缺陷重复出现时留下流程级复盘记录而非仅个案修复。
intentContract.forbiddenBehavior: 把渲染、构建、生成等生产步骤的完成直接当作成功并跳过与预期目标的比对即宣告交付，使缺陷逃逸到下游、迫使 Owner 成为事实上的第一缺陷发现人；以及同类缺陷反复出现时只做点状修复而不修正流程结构。
intentContract.evidenceSource: 诊断事实：流程将渲染步骤定义为终点；交付宣告处无任何确定性拦截机制；质量确认被外置为对 Owner 反馈的被动响应；同类缺陷反复出现而仅被点状修复。
intentContract.validationExpectation: 评估者应要求：由此原则生成的每条规则都包含'交付宣告前存在可观察的显式比对/验证动作'这一硬性条件，且比对对象必须是预期目标而非泛泛的'检查'；若某条规则允许在终末生产步骤完成后直接宣告交付，或把验证降级为可选建议，则与该意图相悖，应被标记而非接受。

risks: 与核心公理 T-07（执行后须观察比对、验证才算成功）和 T-05（硬约束翻译为显式护栏与禁止转移）存在实质重叠——本原则可视为二者在'交付宣告'场景的组合具体化；入原则库时需去重，或明确其增量为：交付点作为终末门禁阶段的结构化定位 + 重复缺陷的流程级重设计路由
过度门禁风险：对所有任务（含低风险小任务）强加全量自审与评审会增加延迟与成本，并可能与 T-06（最简干预、改动最小化）冲突；须以'门禁强度与交付后果严重性成正比'加以约束
门禁误判风险：当缺乏可判定的'通过'标准时，过严验证可能阻断合格交付或引发无限复审循环
第二双眼睛评审依赖外部资源：顾问不可用或评审质量不稳定时，门禁可能失效或沦为形式化走过场
表述强度风险：若被误读为'任何交付都必须全量验证'，可能催生僵化规则；规则生成阶段须保留比例性裁量空间

principleDraft.title: 交付前验证门禁：完成执行≠成功，验证通过前不得宣告交付
principleDraft.statement: 向干系人宣告交付任何产出前，执行者必须主动完成显式验证：将实际输出与预期目标逐项比对（全量自审），并在可行时主动发起独立评审；验证通过前不得进入交付状态，渲染/构建/生成等终末步骤的完成不构成交付标志。质量确认是执行者的自主职责，不得外置为对干系人反馈的被动等待；同类缺陷重复出现时应视为流程反馈信号，触发流程级复盘重设计而非仅点状修复。
principleDraft.rationale: 根因是交付流程的结构性缺陷：渲染被定义为流程终点，交付宣告处不存在任何确定性拦截机制，质量确认被外置为对 Owner 截图反馈的被动响应，导致 v3k8-v3k19 全部 13+ 缺陷均由 Owner 第一时间发现、被迫充当默认 QA 关卡。将'未经验证不得交付'固化为显式终末验证阶段并内化为执行者职责，可从结构上消除缺陷逃逸缺口；同时把重复缺陷视为流程反馈信号，防止点状修复掩盖流程缺陷并让同一错误模式无限重复。
applicability: 多步骤生产/执行流程中向干系人（Owner、客户等）交付产出的场景，如内容生产、代码构建、文档生成
存在易被误当作完成标志的终末步骤（渲染、构建、编译、生成）的工作流
同类缺陷在多轮迭代中重复出现的交付场景，应触发流程级复盘
'主动验证'的具体形态需按领域重新定义（内容生产→全片自审+顾问评审；代码→测试+审查），原则不绑定特定工具或检查清单
antiPatterns: 渲染/构建完成即宣告交付，未对实际输出做任何主动自审与目标比对
质检外置：等待 Owner 截图/反馈后再修复，使其成为事实上的第一缺陷发现人与默认 QA 关卡
交付流程中无确定性拦截，验证仅依赖执行者自觉
同类缺陷重复出现 13+ 次仍只做点状修复，不修正流程结构

intentContract.ownerIntent: Owner 不愿再充当交付流程的第一缺陷发现人：缺陷必须在执行者交付前的主动验证中被拦截，而不是等 Owner 截图反馈后才暴露。
intentContract.targetBehavior: 在工具轨迹中可见：宣告交付之前，执行者主动对全部产出进行自审、（可行时）发起独立评审，并将实际结果与预期目标逐项比对；终末步骤完成时可见交付宣告被阻断直至验证通过；同类缺陷重复出现时可见流程级复盘而非仅点状修复。
intentContract.forbiddenBehavior: 将渲染等终末步骤的完成直接当作交付成功并宣告交付——交付前零主动审计、零主动评审，质量确认被外置为等待 Owner 反馈后再修复的被动响应。
intentContract.evidenceSource: 诊断 manual_1789299059630_zqx0o38o 的 Owner 报告：v3k8-v3k19 全部 13+ 缺陷由 Owner 截图第一时间发现，主会话交付前零主动全片审计、零主动顾问评审；Owner 明确要求渲染后强制自审全片并主动进行 GPT 顾问评审。注意该证据为 owner_reported_no_host_trace，无会话 trace 佐证。
intentContract.validationExpectation: 评估者应要求任何由此生成的规则满足：①在交付宣告点设置确定性拦截（未通过验证不得交付）；②强制执行者主动自审并与预期目标比对，而非由 Owner 反馈触发检查；③允许按领域重定义'主动验证'形态，不绑死特定工具或清单。若规则允许未验证即宣告交付，或验证仅在 Owner 指出后才发生，则违背本意图，应被否决而非修补保留。

risks: 与核心公理 T-07（执行后须观察比对、验证才算成功）和 T-05（硬约束应翻译为显式护栏与禁止转移）存在重叠，本质是二者在交付场景的组合应用；入原则库时需去重或明确其增量定位，避免原则库冗余
过度门禁风险：对低风险、低后果的小任务强加全量自审与独立评审会增加延迟与成本，门禁强度应与交付后果的严重性成正比
门禁误判风险：缺乏可判定的'通过'标准时，过严验证可能阻断合格交付或引发无限复审循环
主动独立评审依赖外部资源（如 GPT 顾问）时，若顾问不可用或评审质量不稳定，门禁可能失效或沦为形式化走过场
实证基础受限：诊断证据为 Owner 主观报告（owner_reported_no_host_trace，无 trace 佐证，诊断置信度 0.55），原则的因果链未经独立验证，建议在具备完整 trace 的会话中复报以增强

parsed.thesis: 执行完成不等于交付成功：'完成'的定义必须内含对实际产物的主动验证，而非以流程信号（如渲染退出成功）或 Owner 的被动反馈为依据。质量确认是执行者的自主职责，交付宣告处应存在失败关闭的验证门禁（产物自审 + 独立评审通过方可放行），使 Owner 永不沦为默认 QA 关卡；同类缺陷反复出现是流程级信号，必须固化为工作流必经步骤并持久化，而非逐次打补丁。

principleCandidate.title: 验证门禁式交付：未经产物自审与独立评审通过，不得宣告完成
principleCandidate.rationale: 根因是交付模式将'流程跑完'当作'产物合格'，验证被隐式外包给 Owner 的截图反馈，渲染→交付之间存在无校验的裸状态转移。将交付依据从流程信号改为对实际产物的直接观察（抽帧核对文案、画面、时序与预期规格），并以'自审通过 + 独立评审通过'作为宣告交付的强制前置条件，才能把缺陷拦截在到达 Owner 之前；同时将重复缺陷模式根因分析固化为必经流程步骤并持久化，防止下一轮重演。
principleCandidate.scope: 适用于任何向 Owner/用户宣告完成、交付或成功的场景，尤其是产物型任务（文档、代码、渲染、报告、设计稿）以及已出现多轮同类缺陷反馈的迭代流程；不适用于无明确预期目标的纯探索性中间过程。

与 T-05（硬约束转化为显式护栏与禁止转移）及 T-08（失败反馈转化为行为改进）存在部分重叠，需在入库时明确差异化定位：本原则聚焦'交付宣告'这一特定状态转移
自审 + 独立评审的双重门禁会显著增加交付延迟与成本，在低风险或时间紧迫场景可能造成过度流程化
门禁标准若不明确（验收基准、评审者可用性），失败关闭可能导致交付僵局或评审主观化

principleDraft.title: 验证门禁式交付：未通过产物自审与独立评审，不得宣告完成
principleDraft.statement: 向 Owner/用户宣告任何任务"完成/交付/成功"之前，必须基于对实际产物的直接检查（而非流程完成信号）完成主动验证：先对产物全量自审并与预期规格逐项比对，再主动发起独立评审，两者均通过方可宣告交付，任一未通过即视为未完成并修复后重验；质量确认是执行者的自主职责，不得以 Owner 的被动反馈作为第一道质检。当同类缺陷在多轮迭代中重复出现时，必须将其根因固化为交付工作流的必经验证步骤并持久化，而非逐次修补。
principleDraft.rationale: 根因是交付流程将"流程跑完"当作"产物合格"：以渲染退出成功等流程信号宣告交付，质检被隐式外包给 Owner 的截图反馈，渲染→交付之间存在无校验的裸状态转移，导致 v3k8-v3k19 全部 13+ 缺陷由 Owner 第一时间发现、Owner 沦为默认 QA 关卡。将交付依据改为对实际产物的直接观察（逐段/抽帧核对文案、画面、时序与预期规格），并以失败关闭的双重门禁（自审通过 + 独立评审通过）作为宣告交付的强制前置条件，才能把缺陷拦截在到达 Owner 之前；将重复缺陷模式固化为必经流程步骤并持久化，防止下一轮重演。
applicability: 任何向 Owner/用户宣告完成、交付或成功的场景，尤其是产物型任务（文档、代码、渲染视频、报告、设计稿）
已出现多轮同类缺陷反馈的迭代交付流程——同类缺陷重复出现即视为流程级信号
交付宣告构成状态转移（执行中→已交付）的工作流节点，在该节点部署失败关闭门禁
边界：不适用于无明确预期目标、无预期规格可比对的纯探索性中间过程
antiPatterns: 以流程完成信号（渲染退出成功、命令返回 0、构建通过）直接推断产物合格并宣告交付
交付前零产物自审、零独立评审，依赖 Owner 截图反馈充当第一道质检，使 Owner 沦为默认 QA 关卡
仅在 Owner 报告缺陷后被动响应修复，且同类缺陷多轮重复仍不修改交付流程
验证仅依赖执行者自觉而无失败关闭门禁，存在"未验证也可宣告交付"的路径

intentContract.ownerIntent: Owner 希望缺陷在到达自己之前被拦截：交付宣告前必须主动全片自审实际产物并主动发起独立（GPT 顾问）评审，而不是像 v3k8-v3k19 那样靠 Owner 截图反馈才发现 13+ 缺陷。
intentContract.targetBehavior: 在任何交付/完成宣告之前，可观察到代理对实际产物的直接检查记录（如逐段/抽帧核对文案、画面、时序与预期规格）以及一次主动发起的独立评审，两者通过后才宣告交付；同类缺陷重复出现后，可观察到交付流程被固化为含必经验证步骤并持久化到项目记忆。
intentContract.forbiddenBehavior: 以流程完成信号（如渲染退出成功）作为交付依据、未经产物自审与独立评审即宣告完成，把 Owner 的反馈当作第一道质检关卡；对重复出现的同类缺陷只做逐次修补而不修改交付流程。
intentContract.evidenceSource: Owner 手工报告（provenance: owner_reported_no_host_trace，无会话 trace 佐证）：v3k8-v3k19 全部 13+ 缺陷均由 Owner 截图第一时间发现，交付前零主动全片审计、零主动顾问评审；Owner 明确要求渲染后强制自审全片并主动进行 GPT 顾问评审。
intentContract.validationExpectation: 评估者应要求：轨迹中每次交付宣告前存在对实际产物的检查证据与独立评审的发起记录，不存在仅凭流程成功信号即宣告交付的案例；同类缺陷再次出现前，工作流已固化并持久化验证步骤；由本原则生成的规则应在交付/完成宣告触发词处执行失败关闭拦截，且拦截动作与上述行为一致而非泛化的"要小心"式提醒。

risks: 与核心公理 T-07 高度重叠，并在门禁设计（T-05）与缺陷反馈流程化（T-08）上部分重叠：本原则是三者 在"交付宣告"这一特定状态转移上的强化与具体化（新增失败关闭门禁、独立第二视角、Owner 不作为默认 QA），入库时须明确定位为具体化而非重复条目
自审 + 独立评审的双重门禁会显著增加交付延迟与成本，在低风险或时间紧迫场景可能造成过度流程化
门禁标准不明确（验收基准、独立评审者可用性）时，失败关闭可能导致交付僵局或评审主观化
若缺陷根因源于需求本身模糊，将验证流程固化可能把错误的验收标准永久写入工作流，反而放大偏差
实证基础薄弱：诊断仅基于 Owner 主观报告（无 trace 佐证），且"主动验证"的具体形态需按领域重新定义，落地时存在退化为特定工具或固定检查清单等规则级表述的风险

principleDraft.title: 验证门禁式交付：未经产物自审与独立评审通过，不得宣告完成
principleDraft.statement: 向 Owner 宣告任何任务'完成/交付/成功'之前，必须先通过直接观察实际产物（对照预期规格逐项核对内容要素，如文案、画面、时序）完成自审，并经一次独立评审通过；二者构成失败关闭的交付门禁——门禁未通过或无法执行时不得宣告完成。流程信号（渲染/构建/命令退出成功）不得作为合格依据，Owner 的被动反馈不得作为默认 QA 环节。同类缺陷被反馈两次及以上后，必须将其根因分析与对应检查固化为工作流必经步骤并持久化，而非仅做单次修补。
principleDraft.rationale: 根因是交付模式将'流程跑完'等同于'产物合格'：渲染（或构建/执行）到交付宣告之间存在无校验的裸状态转移，验证被隐式外包给 Owner 的截图反馈。将交付依据从流程信号改为对实际产物的直接观察，并以'自审通过 + 独立评审通过'为宣告交付的强制前置条件，可把缺陷拦截在到达 Owner 之前；对重复缺陷固化必经验证步骤并持久化，可阻断'逐次打补丁'的重演循环。
applicability: 任何向 Owner/用户宣告完成、交付或成功的场景
产物型任务：文档、代码、渲染产物（视频/图像）、报告、设计稿等可直接核验的交付物
渲染/构建/执行成功退出之后、交付宣告之前的状态转移环节
已出现多轮同类缺陷反馈的迭代流程（重复缺陷的流程固化与持久化）
antiPatterns: 以流程信号（渲染退出成功、构建通过、命令返回 0）替代对实际产物的直接观察即宣告完成
把 Owner 当作默认 QA：依赖 Owner 的截图或反馈来发现本应由执行者自审拦截的缺陷
在渲染/构建成功与交付宣告之间执行无验证门禁的裸状态转移
验证门禁非失败关闭：自审或独立评审无法执行（评审者不可用、验收基准缺失）时默认放行交付
同类缺陷被 Owner 逐轮纠正后仅做一次性修补，不将根因检查固化为工作流必经步骤，导致下一轮重演

intentContract.ownerIntent: Owner 希望收到'完成/交付'宣告时，产物已经过执行者的主动验证合格（自审通过且独立评审通过），自己永远不必充当默认 QA 关卡，且同类缺陷不再逐轮重演。
intentContract.targetBehavior: 在轨迹中，任何交付宣告之前可见：(a) 对实际产物的直接检验（如对渲染结果抽帧逐项核对文案、画面、时序与预期规格）；(b) 自审通过记录；(c) 一次独立评审通过记录；三者齐备后才出现完成宣告；同类缺陷被反馈后，可见后续每轮执行都包含由该缺陷固化而来的必经检查步骤且被持久化引用。
intentContract.forbiddenBehavior: 以'渲染/构建/命令执行成功'等流程信号直接宣告完成而未直接观察产物；依赖 Owner 截图反馈来发现本应自审拦截的缺陷；验证环节缺失或无法执行时仍放行交付；同类缺陷仅做一次性修补而不固化工作流，导致重复发生。
intentContract.evidenceSource: 蒸馏自诊断事实：'渲染退出成功'被当作交付依据，渲染→交付之间为无校验的裸状态转移，产物缺陷（文案/画面/时序不符预期规格）由 Owner 通过截图反馈逐轮发现，且同类缺陷在多轮迭代中反复出现、仅被逐次打补丁。
intentContract.validationExpectation: 评审者应确认任何由此生成的规则：(1) 明确禁止以流程信号作为完成宣告的合格依据；(2) 要求交付前存在对实际产物的直接观察验证、自审记录与独立第二视角评审，且门禁失败关闭（无法验证时不得宣告完成）；(3) 要求重复缺陷根因固化为持久化必经步骤。若后续修复轮次的改动删除上述任一要素（例如允许在评审者不可用时默认放行），应被标记为违背本意图而非直接实施。

risks: 与核心公理 T-07 高度重叠：T-07 已要求'执行后观察结果并与预期比对才算成功'，本原则是其向'交付宣告'场景的强化与门禁化（失败关闭、独立第二视角、Owner 不作为默认 QA、重复缺陷固化），入库时需定位为场景化细化而非重复条目
与 T-05（硬约束转化为显式护栏与禁止转移——本原则将'宣告完成'定义为受门禁约束的转移）及 T-08（失败反馈转化为行为改进——本原则要求重复缺陷固化为必经步骤）存在部分重叠，需明确差异化边界
双重门禁（自审 + 独立评审）会显著增加交付延迟与成本，在低风险或时间紧迫场景可能造成过度流程化
门禁验收标准不明确或独立评审者不可用时，失败关闭可能导致交付僵局或评审主观化
若缺陷根因实际源于需求本身模糊，固化流程可能把错误标准永久写入工作流，放大系统性偏差
越界适用于无明确预期目标的纯探索性中间过程会阻碍探索效率并增加无谓验证开销

candidates.badDecision: 将渲染完成直接等同于交付成功，未将实际渲染输出与预期目标进行任何比对即宣告交付
candidates.betterDecision: 渲染完成后强制执行全片自审，将实际渲染结果与预期目标逐项比对，验证通过后才允许宣告交付
candidates.rationale: 完成执行不等于验证成功（T-07）；主动比对能在交付前暴露缺陷，避免Owner被迫充当第一缺陷发现人与默认QA关卡

candidates.badDecision: 将质检外置为对Owner截图反馈的被动响应环节，交付前零主动审计、零主动顾问评审
candidates.betterDecision: 在交付流程中内建主动质检步骤：渲染后主动执行全片审查并主动发起GPT顾问评审，而非等待Owner反馈后被动修复
candidates.rationale: 质量确认是执行者的自主职责，不应外置为对外部反馈的被动响应；被动质检将缺陷发现成本系统性转嫁给Owner，v3k8-v3k19全部13+缺陷由Owner第一时间发现即为此模式的直接后果

candidates.badDecision: 交付流程未将'未经验证不得交付'的质量约束转化为显式的质检门禁与禁止状态转移
candidates.betterDecision: 在交付宣告处部署确定性质检门禁：识别到'渲染完成/宣告交付'等触发模式时阻断交付宣告，强制先完成全片自审与顾问评审，验证通过后方可执行交付状态转移
candidates.rationale: 硬约束只有转化为显式护栏、检查与禁止转移才能可靠生效（T-05）；依赖执行者自觉遵守的软约束在多轮迭代压力下必然失守，确定性拦截才能消除对人为纪律的依赖

candidates.badDecision: v3k8-v3k19多轮迭代中同类缺陷反复出现，却仅做单点缺陷修复，未将失败反馈固化为流程层改进，持续沿用无验证交付模式
candidates.betterDecision: 首次出现'交付后由Owner发现缺陷'时即复盘交付流程，将该失败模式抽象为流程规则（如强制质检门禁）并落地，阻断同类错误再次发生
candidates.rationale: 失败与纠正应作为反馈改进未来行为（T-08）；同类缺陷重复13+次表明缺乏反馈内化机制，仅修复症状而不修正流程无法阻断复发

candidates.badDecision: 交付前独自判断交付质量，未主动调用可用的GPT顾问评审等外部验证资源，仅凭自身视角宣称结果符合预期
candidates.rationale: 独立评审视角能覆盖自审盲区；基于可观察证据（渲染输出）并引入独立复核后再宣称结果（T-03），成本远低于Owner事后发现缺陷的返工与信任损耗

parsed.thesis: Execution completion is not success; the executor owns the quality gate. A delivery declaration is legitimate only after proactively comparing the actual output against the intended goal, reinforced by independent review. Defect discovery must never be externalized to the recipient as passive feedback, and recurring failure patterns must be hardened from soft discipline into explicit pre-delivery gates.

principleCandidate.title: Declare delivery only after self-owned verification with independent review
principleCandidate.rationale: The root failure was treating execution completion as delivery success and implicitly outsourcing quality assurance to the Owner, who became the default defect discoverer (13+ defects across v3k8-v3k19). Making verification a proactive, self-owned step—comparing actual rendered output against intended goals and invoking independent review before any delivery declaration—catches defects before handoff, stops transferring rework cost and trust loss to the recipient, and removes reliance on discipline that erodes under iterative pressure.
principleCandidate.scope: Applies whenever an agent completes an execution phase and is about to declare success or hand off a deliverable to a stakeholder—especially in multi-round iterative workflows where repeated post-delivery defect discovery by the recipient signals that verification discipline has failed and must be institutionalized as an explicit gate.

risks: Partially overlaps T-07 ('execution is not success until verified') and T-05 (explicit gates); the distinguishing core—never externalizing defect discovery to the recipient—must be preserved or the principle adds nothing beyond existing axioms.
Mandatory independent review can stall or deadlock delivery when reviewer resources are slow or unavailable; the gate needs a defined degradation path rather than blocking indefinitely.
Uniform verification depth adds latency and cost to every cycle; verification rigor should scale with deliverable risk instead of being applied indiscriminately.
If the independent reviewer shares the executor's evidence base or blind spots, the review yields false assurance rather than genuine coverage of defects.

principleDraft.title: Delivery requires self-owned verification, independent review, and an explicit pre-delivery gate
principleDraft.statement: Before any success declaration or deliverable handoff, the agent must (1) compare the actual rendered final output against the intended goal using observable evidence, (2) subject the deliverable to an independent review whose evidence base is not solely the executor's own, and (3) record the verification result; if a recipient discovers a defect class after delivery, the agent must convert that class into an explicit pre-delivery check gate before the next handoff rather than relying on renewed caution.
principleDraft.rationale: The root failure was treating execution completion as delivery success, which implicitly outsourced quality assurance to the Owner and made the recipient the default defect discoverer (13+ defects across v3k8-v3k19). Making verification a proactive, self-owned step—comparing actual rendered output against intended goals and invoking independent review before any delivery declaration—catches defects before handoff, stops transferring rework cost and trust loss to the recipient, and institutionalizes as an explicit gate the discipline that erodes under iterative pressure.
applicability: Any transition from execution to declaration: marking a task complete, reporting success, or handing off a deliverable to a stakeholder
Multi-round iterative workflows where the recipient has previously found defects after delivery (recipient-as-QA signal)
Deliverables whose defects are only visible by inspecting the rendered final output against stated goals (rendering, formatting, integration surfaces)
Handoffs where recipient-discovered defects carry asymmetric cost: rework, schedule slip, or loss of trust
antiPatterns: Treating execution completion (command exit, file written, code merged) as sufficient grounds for declaring success
Externalizing defect discovery to the recipient by making the Owner's feedback the de facto QA loop
Self-review that re-reads the executor's assumptions or intermediate artifacts instead of inspecting the rendered final output against the goal
Leaving a defect class the recipient already caught as a soft 'be more careful' note instead of an explicit pre-delivery check
Silently waiving the review gate under schedule pressure instead of escalating the gap explicitly

intentContract.ownerIntent: The Owner wants the agent to find and fix defects itself before handoff, instead of the Owner repeatedly acting as the default defect discoverer (13+ defects across v3k8-v3k19).
intentContract.targetBehavior: In every pre-handoff trajectory, the agent visibly compares the rendered final output against the stated goal, invokes an independent review, records a pass/fail verification result, and only then declares delivery; defect classes previously caught by the recipient appear as named checks in later gates.
intentContract.forbiddenBehavior: Declaring success on execution completion alone and letting the recipient discover defects, so the Owner becomes the QA loop and recurring defect classes are answered only with renewed caution instead of explicit gates.
intentContract.evidenceSource: Diagnosis of the multi-round manual workflow: 13+ defects (v3k8-v3k19) were discovered by the Owner after delivery, showing verification was treated as complete at execution end.
intentContract.validationExpectation: An evaluator should accept a rule only if it requires recorded output-vs-goal comparison plus an independent review step preceding every delivery declaration, and requires recipient-caught defect classes to be added as explicit checks before the next handoff; a rule that permits success declaration on execution completion, or that waives review silently, contradicts this intent.

risks: Substantial overlap with T-07 (execution is not success until verified) and T-05 (translate hard constraints into explicit checks): the differentiating core — never externalizing defect discovery to the recipient and institutionalizing recipient-caught defect classes as gates — must be preserved, or the principle adds nothing beyond existing axioms.

Mandatory independent review can stall or deadlock delivery when reviewers are slow or unavailable; the gate needs a defined degradation path (e.g., explicit escalation or flagged-as-unreviewed handoff) rather than blocking indefinitely.
Uniform verification depth adds latency and cost to every cycle; rigor should scale with deliverable risk rather than being applied indiscriminately.

An 'independent' reviewer sharing the executor's evidence base or blind spots yields false assurance rather than genuine defect coverage; independence must be defined over evidence and perspective, not role alone.
Accumulating every historical defect into the gate can bloat the checklist until verification becomes a bottleneck; gate checks should be pruned when a defect class stops recurring.

principleDraft.title: Declare delivery only after self-owned verification with independent review
principleDraft.statement: Before declaring an execution phase complete or handing a deliverable to a stakeholder, the executor must proactively verify it: perform a full self-review of the actual output comparing it against the intended goal, and proactively initiate independent review (e.g., advisor review) when such a resource is available. If the recipient has previously discovered defects after handoff, that recurring failure pattern must be hardened into an explicit pre-delivery verification gate instead of relying on discipline alone. Defect discovery must never be externalized to the recipient as passive feedback.
principleDraft.rationale: The root cause was a delivery process that defined execution (rendering) as the endpoint and externalized quality control into passive responses to the Owner's screenshot feedback — making the Owner the first discoverer of all 13+ defects across v3k8–v3k19 while the session performed zero pre-delivery full-output self-audits and zero proactive advisor reviews. Making verification a self-owned step executed before the delivery declaration catches defects before handoff, stops transferring rework cost and trust loss to the recipient, and — by hardening already-observed failure patterns into explicit gates — removes reliance on discipline that erodes under multi-round iterative pressure.
applicability: When an agent completes an execution phase (rendering, code change, document or content generation) and is about to declare success or hand off a deliverable

Multi-round iterative delivery workflows where the recipient has previously discovered defects after delivery, signaling that verification discipline has failed and must be institutionalized as an explicit gate
Any delivery declaration or completion state transition (e.g., 'render done', 'delivery complete') that marks work as finished
antiPatterns: Equating execution completion with delivery success — declaring completion without comparing the actual output against the intended goal
Zero proactive verification before handoff: no full self-review of the actual output and no proactively initiated independent/advisor review
Externalizing defect discovery: waiting for the recipient's screenshots or feedback to surface defects, then fixing them passively
Point-fixing recipient-discovered defects across multiple rounds without converting the recurring failure pattern into an explicit pre-delivery verification gate

intentContract.ownerIntent: The Owner wants to stop being the default QA gate: the agent must proactively self-review the full actual output and initiate an advisor review before declaring delivery, so defects surface pre-handoff rather than through Owner screenshot feedback.
intentContract.targetBehavior: In the agent trajectory, between execution completion and the delivery declaration, there is an observable verification sequence: a full self-review of the actual output compared against the intended goal, plus a proactively initiated independent (advisor) review, both completed and recorded before the delivery/success declaration is made.
intentContract.forbiddenBehavior: Declaring delivery or success immediately upon execution completion with no proactive verification; leaving defect discovery to the recipient's post-handoff feedback; and repeatedly absorbing recipient-found defects as point fixes without hardening the pattern into an explicit pre-delivery verification gate.
intentContract.evidenceSource: Owner-reported diagnosis manual_1789299059630_zqx0o38o: all 13+ defects across v3k8–v3k19 were first found by the Owner via screenshots, with zero pre-delivery full-output self-audits and zero proactive GPT advisor reviews; the Owner explicitly demanded mandatory post-render full self-review and proactive advisor review.
intentContract.validationExpectation: An evaluator should accept a rule only if it intercepts the delivery declaration (triggering at completion/delivery statements), requires recorded evidence of actual-vs-intended comparison plus independent review before the declaration passes, and treats a recipient-discovered defect as a signal to install a permanent gate; a rule that merely reminds the agent to 'double-check', or permits delivery without recorded verification results, contradicts this intent.

risks: Partially overlaps T-07 (verify after acting) and T-05 (convert constraints into explicit gates); the distinguishing core — defect discovery must never be externalized to the recipient, with self-owned verification and independent review required before the declaration — must be preserved or the principle adds nothing beyond existing axioms.

The evidence base is a single Owner report with no session trace (owner_reported_no_host_trace; diagnosis confidence 0.55); the causal chain and defect counts are uncorroborated and should be re-validated once full traces are available.

Mandatory independent review can stall or deadlock delivery when advisor resources are slow or unavailable; the gate needs a defined degradation path (e.g., self-review plus explicit disclosure that independent review was skipped) rather than blocking indefinitely.
Uniform verification depth adds latency and cost to every cycle; verification rigor should scale with deliverable risk instead of being applied indiscriminately.
If the independent reviewer shares the executor's evidence base or blind spots, the review yields false assurance rather than genuine defect coverage.
Domain over-fit risk: 'full self-review' must be re-specified per domain (full playback review for rendered media, tests/builds for code) to avoid degenerating into a render-specific checklist.
